name: studio
description: Plan a new product end to end before any code: /idea runs office hours, /niche researches the category into an interface thesis, /founder-review settles scope, /brand finds a free name and draws the icon, /design-system locks one distinctive design system as tokens, /design-variants and /mockups design every screen as HTML, /design-review scores it and checks drift, /tech-plan fixes the stack, architecture and code rules, /launch-kit writes the store listings, screenshots and landing page. /studio-flow runs them in order.
